classification: controlled address-mapping stress; not a natural Qwen3 workload
alias_transform: mapped_bank = original_decoded_bank mod effective_banks; row and column bits unchanged
balanced_transform: mapped_bank = splitmix64(op_id || transaction_index) mod 16; row and column bits unchanged
paired_oracle: only cross-request same-Bank timing blockers removed; global row state preserved

same row and column address bits
limitations: alias mapping can make distinct original physical addresses collide after Bank-bit compression
timing stress only; no functional data-value simulation
